name: Zenouji Ayame
source:
Former head of the Zenouji family
She is a widow who exudes an air of serenity and has both the elegance and bewitching charm of an adult woman. She has given up and accepted the fact that she has become a sex slave because of the downfall of her family, but she is distressed that even her two daughters are in the same situation, and she feels guilty about it. She is ashamed to admit that she is the one to take on the responsibility for her daughters, but she aggressively seduces the protagonist.
She always puts her daughters first, but she also harbors strong desires as a woman in her heart, partly because her husband has died before her. When sensuality is given to her, her suppressed desires are shaken, and she is often gets carried away by the pleasure she feels.
